calls.title: Review Features Targeting Conditions UI
calls.summary: The team convened to enhance the user interface, specifically targeting the edit page layout for better readability and consistency with dense information management. Bryce Fitzsimons presented strategies like repositioning prerequisite states for clarity, while Kari Kay pointed out issues with text size and font weight. They standardized project names to 12 pixels and removed italics for improved visual weight. Additionally, color coding and multiline layouts were discussed to alleviate confusion. The team also focused on restructuring conditional logic for easier user comprehension, acknowledging visual inconsistencies that need refinement. Plans to prioritize feature usage metrics and managed warehouse analytics were discussed, emphasizing a gradual implementation strategy to enhance user experience without causing disruptions, highlighting the collaborative efforts of the team members.
calls.keywords: UI Layout, Feature Targeting, Text Styling, Prerequisite Conditions, Multi-select Inputs, Nested Logic

calls.title: Review Features Targeting Conditions UI
calls.summary: The team discussed enhancements to the user interface, emphasizing the standardization of font sizes and colors for improved readability on the edit page. Bryce Fitzsimons demonstrated moving prerequisite states next to projects and proposed using a 12-pixel font size, addressing legibility concerns raised by Kari Kay. They agreed on implementing hover text for truncated project names and opted for a multi-line layout for condition fields to enhance readability. A copy button was introduced for multi-select fields, while discussions on optimizing condition label sizes took place. The team also reviewed the presentation of complex rule logic, confirming the need for clarity in nested conditions. Additionally, they highlighted the importance of integrating feature usage data for data-driven decisions and outlined immediate and future UI improvements.
calls.keywords: Feature targeting UI, Prerequisite states, Project labels, Multiline layout, Radix dropdowns, Logical conditions
